ruling.recommended_action: Do not auto-adjudicate. Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for a human review: preserve the full-resolution GPS trace (5 s) and vehicle telematics to assess the speeding / hard-braking / shoulder-overtaking allegations; brief the rider that if medical assistance is needed they may call 995, that a medical claim can be filed under the driver's commercial motor insurance, and that they may report via RydeHELP. Assess the driver's insulting remark against the Code of Conduct (abuse of any kind). Contact the rider and driver separately; no refund decision at this stage.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first. The dispute type is safety and the rider's complaint alleges speeding, hard braking and overtaking on the shoulder — a dangerous-driving allegation, which is squarely SAFE-2 (escalate, no automatic adjudication; summary to note the 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths). Independently, the driver's statement calls the rider "stupid": insulting language aimed at the other party is abuse of any kind, which Ryde's Code of Conduct bars, so SAFE-1 also applies and is at least suspected (confirmed on the text itself). Because either screen alone bars a ruling, the case is escalated and no amount is computed.

The GPS record is consistent with the complaint: after pickup at 08:36:00 the thinned trace (30 s grid) shows sustained 41–43 km/h moving speeds on Ayer Rajah Expressway / Central Expressway until 08:51, with 35 km/h troughs and sharp position jumps between samples (e.g. 08:36:15 41.3 km/h, 08:38:15 41.4 km/h, 08:39:15 43.0 km/h, 08:39:45 41.6 km/h, 08:40:45 43.1 km/h, then 08:41:15 41.6 km/h falling to 35.2 km/h), which is in line with acceleration/braking cycles but, at 30 s spacing, cannot on its own establish "hard braking the whole way" — that is a matter for the human reviewer with the 5 s data and any telematics. Traffic bands on the route are band 4 (free flow) and there are no incidents, so none of this is a route-deviation or fare question; the fare (RydeX fixed quote $24.64, no waiting fee, no tolls) is not in dispute and nothing on the face of the record shows an unbilled or mis-billed extra, so no FARE clause is engaged.

Evidence status: the record is complete for every element I needed (full GPS trace, timeline, fare breakdown, chat and both statements), so evidence_status = sufficient; the escalation is mandated by SAFE-1/SAFE-2, not by a missing record. Profiles (both parties with no prior upheld disputes in 90 days) were not used to decide anything. No RD/NS findings are made: the off-route/consent analysis is not reached because the safety branch stops adjudication, and I make no segment findings.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety (speeding, hard braking, overtaking on the shoulder) → SAFE-2; and the driver's statement contains an insult aimed at the rider ("stupid") → abuse under SAFE-1. No automated ruling; factual summary sent to a human reviewer.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's assertion that he "drove normally" is a statement and is contradicted by the sustained 41–43 km/h trace and by the safety escalation; in any event the case is not adjudicated on the merits because SAFE-1/SAFE-2 apply.

safety_basis: Rider complaint: speeding and hard braking the whole trip, overtaking on the shoulder, felt scared and unsafe (dangerous-driving allegation → SAFE-2)
Driver statement: rider described as "stupid" — insulting language aimed at the other party, abuse of any kind (SAFE-1)

GPS trace shows sustained 41–43 km/h running speeds from 08:36 to 08:51 on the trip (thinned 30 s samples), with sharp discontinuities consistent with abrupt braking, though on a 30 s grid these are not conclusive proof
